# A key whose grant can only ever attempt a write

A grant may pin an action to dry-run mode. A key holding that grant cannot
perform the action for real, even when its own request asks for a live write.

## Mint the keys

```bash
rimsky auth init --endpoint "$BASE"
```

`role-attempt-only.json`:

```json
{
  "name": "attempt-only",
  "description": "May attempt a tag create; the grant pins it to dry-run.",
  "permissions": [
    { "action": "tag:create", "mode": "dry_run" },
    { "action": "tag:read" },
    { "action": "template:read" }
  ]
}
```

`role-execute.json` — the same action with no mode pin, as a control:

```json
{
  "name": "execute-control",
  "permissions": [
    { "action": "tag:create" },
    { "action": "tag:read" },
    { "action": "template:read" }
  ]
}
```

```bash
rimsky auth create-key --name=attempt-only   --role-file=role-attempt-only.json \
  --endpoint "$BASE" --key "$ADMIN"
rimsky auth create-key --name=execute-control --role-file=role-execute.json \
  --endpoint "$BASE" --key "$ADMIN"
```

## What the product does

The pinned key's plain write — no flag on the request at all:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/v1/tags" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ATTEMPT" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tag":"floor-a@1","template":"'"$TPL"'"}'
# {"dry_run":true,"would_have_created_tag":{...}}

curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" "$BASE/v1/tags"
# floor-a@1 is absent
```

The holder cannot lift the floor its own grant sets:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/v1/tags?dry_run=false" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ATTEMPT" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tag":"floor-b@1","template":"'"$TPL"'"}'
# the same synthetic envelope; floor-b@1 is absent too
```

The unpinned control key performs the real write and its tag persists, so the
floor is the grant's doing and not the deployment's.

The pinned key keeps its read grant throughout and stays a working credential
for what it was granted.

An operator can hand an autonomous agent a credential that can only ever attempt
the write.

## The proviso

The floor holds only while no other grant on the key authorizes execute mode on
that action. A key carrying both grants performs the real write:

```json
{
  "name": "mixed",
  "permissions": [
    { "action": "tag:create", "mode": "dry_run" },
    { "action": "tag:*" },
    { "action": "template:read" }
  ]
}
```

Pinning one grant does not by itself make a key safe to hand out. Check the
whole permission set.
